data.name: A capability the company can increasingly control for itself
data.value: En evne, som virksomheden kan kontrollere mere og mere selv

data.name: A consistent infrastructure foundation
A foundation designed to evolve with the business.
data.value: Et fundament designet til at udvikle sig sammen med virksomheden.

data.name: A software-only delivery would not solve the problem either. Even a well-designed platform cannot provide the expected performance or reliability when its underlying hardware is unsuitable or poorly integrated. ChopInsight needed a coordinated approach that could preserve existing investments, add computing capacity where necessary, and support conventional applications and AI workloads through a common management model.
data.value: En udelukkende softwarebaseret leverance ville heller ikke løse problemet. Selv en veludformet platform kan ikke levere den forventede ydeevne eller pålidelighed, hvis den underliggende hardware er uegnet eller dårligt integreret. ChopInsight havde brug for en samordnet tilgang, der kunne bevare eksisterende investeringer, tilføje beregningskapacitet, hvor det var nødvendigt, og understøtte konventionelle applikationer og AI-workloads gennem et fælles administrationsmodel.

data.name: About ChopInsight
AI access
AI access governed
AI as a governed enterprise capability

AI introduced a second, closely related challenge. Suitable computing resources could be expensive and complex to specify. ChopInsight needed to avoid hardware that might later prove unsuitable for its software or operational requirements, while simply replacing equipment would have ignored the value of its existing servers.
data.value: AI indførte en anden, tæt relateret udfordring. Egnede beregningsressourcer kunne være dyre og komplekse at specificere. ChopInsight skulle undgå hardware, der senere kunne vise sig uegnet til dets software- eller driftsmæssige krav, mens en simpel udskiftning af udstyret ville have ignoreret værdien af dets eksisterende servere.

data.name: Aiursoft assessed ChopInsight’s physical equipment, computing resources, application requirements and future AI plans together. Performance, stability, cost and future expansion informed a single design, making hardware selection and adaptation part of the service rather than a separate procurement exercise.
data.value: Aiursoft vurderede ChopInsights fysiske udstyr, beregningsressourcer, applikationskrav og fremtidige AI-planer samlet. Ydeevne, stabilitet, omkostninger og fremtidig udvidelse dannede grundlaget for et enkelt design, hvilket gjorde hardwarevalg og tilpasning til en del af tjenesten i stedet for en separat indkøbsproces.

data.name: Aiursoft brought ChopInsight’s existing infrastructure, emerging AI requirements and business applications into one stable, scalable platform—protecting earlier investments while preparing the business for continued AI adoption.
data.value: Aiursoft samlede ChopInsight’s eksisterende infrastruktur, fremvokende AI-krav og forretningsapplikationer i én stabil og skalerbar platform – og beskyttede samtidig tidligere investeringer, mens forretningsdriften blev forberedt til fortsat AI-udbredelse.

data.name: Aiursoft introduced a unified identity layer and connected relevant internal services to it. Users, organisational relationships and access policies could be managed through a common framework, reducing duplicate accounts while establishing a foundation for consistent access governance, service auditing and secure use of internal applications.
data.value: Aiursoft introducerede et samlet identitetslag og tilsluttede de relevante interne tjenester til det. Brugere, organisationelle relationer og adgangspolicyer kunne administreres gennem et fælles rammeværk, hvilket reducerede duplikerede konti samtidig med at det etablerede et fundament for konsistent adgangsstyring, tjenesteudredning og sikker brug af interne applikationer.

data.name: Aiursoft managed platform
Applications can use a unified access model and governed model resources without repeating account administration or AI integration work.
data.value: Applikationer kan bruge et fælles adgangsmøde og regulerede modelressourcer uden at gentage kontoadministration eller AI-integrationsarbejde.

data.name: Applications can use local and compatible external model resources through a consistent enterprise capability.
data.value: Applikationer kan bruge lokale og kompatible eksterne modelressourcer gennem en konsistent virksomhedsfunktion.

data.name: Applications were typically deployed and maintained by their respective software suppliers. That approach worked while the estate was small, but became difficult to sustain as applications accumulated different runtime environments, deployment methods and operational practices. Accounts and permissions were managed separately, dependencies were difficult to understand, and operational information was scattered across multiple systems.
data.value: Applikationer blev typisk udrullet og vedligeholdt af deres respektive softwareleverandører. Denne tilgang fungerede, mens IT-landskabet var lille, men blev vanskeligt at opretholde, da applikationerne akkumulerede forskellige kørselstidsmiljøer, udrulningsmetoder og driftspraksisser. Konti og tilladelser blev håndteret adskilt, afhængigheder var svære at forstå, og driftsinformation var spredt over flere systemer.

data.name: As ChopInsight expanded, it introduced knowledge bases, data analytics, AI-assisted question answering, research tools, collaboration services and a growing number of business applications. Each system addressed a real need, but the infrastructure beneath them had not evolved at the same pace.
data.value: Da ChopInsight udvidede, introducerede det videnbaser, dataanalyse, AI-understøttet spørgssvar, researchværktøjer, samarbejdsservices og et voksende antal forretningsapplikationer. Hvert system imødegik et reelt behov, men infrastrukturen under dem havde ikke udviklet sig i samme tempo.

Essential service status and operational records can also be viewed from a common perspective. Teams can investigate across services, understand critical system use, retain records for long-term auditing and build toward future alerting and operational analysis—without exposing the customer’s detailed internal architecture.
data.value: Status for essentielle tjenester og driftslog kan også vises fra et fælles perspektiv. Hold kan undersøge tværgående over tjenester, forstå kritisk systembrug, opbevare log til langsigtet revision og bygge mod fremtidige alarmer og driftsanalyse — uden at afsløre kundens detaljerede interne arkitektur.

Internal files, research materials, project documents and team collaboration were aligned with the same identity and permission model. For a research organisation with a growing body of specialist material, this simplified everyday collaboration and created a more reliable base for knowledge reuse and AI-assisted research.
data.value: Interne filer, forskningsmateriale, projekt dokumenter og team-samarbejde blev tilpasset samme identitets- og tilladelsesmodel. For en forskningsorganisation med et voksende korpus af specialiseret materiale forenklede dette det daglige samarbejde og skabte et mere pålideligt fundament for genanvendelse af viden og AI-understøttet forskning.

data.name: Investment protected
Investment research

Its competitive advantage comes from a deep understanding of the business models behind underlying assets, combined with expertise in fundamental research, data science, quantitative finance and large language models. Rather than simply delivering information, ChopInsight is building a new research framework around long-term value, deeper insight and a durable technology advantage.
data.value: Dens konkurrencefordel stammer fra en dyb forståelse af de forretningsmodeller, der ligger til grund for de underliggende aktiver, kombineret med ekspertise inden for fundamental analyse, datavidenskab, kvantitativ finans og store sprogmodeller. I stedet for blot at levere informationer, opbygger ChopInsight et nyt forskningsframework baseret på langsigtede værdi, dybere indsigt og en vedvarende teknologisk fordel.

data.name: Knowledge stays with the organisation

Most importantly, technology is less likely to limit the speed of the business. Testing, building and release can proceed through a standardised delivery model, while AI agents can assist with code changes and problem analysis inside an established governance framework.
data.value: Mest vigtigt er, at teknologien i mindre grad begrænser virksomhedens tempo. Testning, opbygning og udgivelse kan gennemføres via en standardiseret leveringsmodel, mens AI-agenter kan understøtte kodeændringer og problemanalyse inden for et etableret styringsrammeværk.

data.value: Ind i en fremtid med AI, én server ad gangen

data.value: Nye tjenester kan bruge fælles udrulnings-, drifts- og operativ praksis i stedet for at introducere endnu et miljø og endnu en vedligeholdelsesansvarlig.

data.name: On this page
One shared platform
Operations

Operations are easier to understand. Service status and essential records are managed from a unified perspective, supporting faster diagnosis, security auditing and future analysis. Rather than contacting several suppliers to identify where a problem belongs, ChopInsight has a clearer view of the environment it operates.
data.value: Driftsoperationer er lettere at forstå. Servicestatus og vigtige optegnelser håndteres fra et samlet perspektiv, hvilket understøtter hurtigere diagnostik, sikkerhedsrevisioner og fremtidig analyse. I stedet for at kontakte flere leverandører for at identificere, hvor et problem hører til, har ChopInsight et klarere overblik over det miljø, det opererer i.

data.name: Operations standardised
Platform architecture overview

Previously, one server would often be associated with one application. Under the new model, servers became computing resources within a shared platform while applications were managed independently of individual machines. Existing capacity could be reused more effectively, workloads could share resources with appropriate separation, and validated new hardware could join the same management model.
data.value: Tidligere var én server ofte knyttet til én applikation. Under det nye model blev servere beregningsressourcer inden for en fælles platform, mens applikationer blev håndteret uafhængigt af individuelle maskiner. Eksisterende kapacitet kunne genbruges mere effektivt, workload kunne dele ressourcer med passende separation, og valideret ny hardware kunne tilsluttes samme administrationsmodel.

data.value: Ressourceplanlægning, hardware-tilpasning og softwareleverance danner nu én løsning, der balancerer AI-ydeevne med stabilitet og omkostninger.

data.name: Several traditional rack servers operated alongside public cloud and externally hosted resources. Acquired at different times, from different sources and for different purposes, they had never been designed or managed as a single environment.
data.value: Flere traditionelle rackservers kørte sammen med offentlige cloud-ressourcer og eksternt hostede ressourcer. De var anskaffet på forskellige tidspunkter, fra forskellige kilder og til forskellige formål, og de var aldrig blevet designet eller administreret som et samlet miljø.

data.name: Shared foundation

Source code, version management and delivery workflows moved into a common platform. Development, validation, release and rollback now follow a repeatable process, while configuration and change history are retained. Developers and AI agents can contribute without making production delivery depend on a sequence known only to one person.
data.value: Kildekode, versionsstyring og leveringsworkflows er flyttet til en fælles platform. Udvikling, validering, frigivelse og tilbagerulning følger nu en gentagelig proces, mens konfiguration og ændringshistorik bevares. Udviklere og AI-agenter kan bidrage, uden at produktionssikker levering bliver afhængig af en rækkefølge, som kun én person kender.

data.name: Talk to Aiursoft

The organisation
The project was more than a server migration. It changed how ChopInsight builds, operates and expands its business systems.
data.value: Projektet var mere end en servermigration. Det ændrede måden, hvor ChopInsight bygger, driver og udvider sine forretningssystemer på.

data.name: The results
The solution

This fragmentation affected day-to-day work. Diagnosing a problem depended heavily on individual experience. Upgrades and migrations often required the original supplier. Some environments became harder to maintain over time, and expanding capacity could mean purchasing more equipment and repeating the same deployment work. When external operations staff changed, valuable knowledge could leave with them.
data.value: Denne fragmentering påvirkede det daglige arbejde. Fejlfinding afhængte sig i høj grad af individuel erfaring. Opgraderinger og migrationer krævede ofte den oprindelige leverandør. Nogle miljøer blev sværere at vedligeholde over tid, og udvidelse af kapaciteten kunne betyde, at man skulle købe mere udstyr og gentage det samme udrulningsarbejde. Når eksterne driftsmedarbejdere skiftede, kunne værdifuld viden forsvinde sammen med dem.

data.name: This separation gave ChopInsight a more flexible foundation. New services no longer had to begin with a standalone environment. Runtime status and upgrades could be managed centrally, and replacing one machine no longer had to become an application-specific infrastructure project.
data.value: Denne separation gav ChopInsight et mere fleksibelt fundament. Nye tjenester behøvede ikke længere at starte med et selvstændigt miljø. Køringsstatus og opgraderinger kunne håndteres centralt, og udskiftning af én maskine behøvede ikke længere at blive et applikationsspecifikt infrastrukturprojekt.

data.name: Turn fragmented infrastructure into a foundation for growth.
data.value: Omdan fragmenteret infrastruktur til et fundament for vækst.

data.name: Unified identity and access
Unified. Stable. Scalable. Governable.
Visit ChopInsight

With suitably adapted local computing resources in place, Aiursoft established a unified entry point for AI services. Users and applications could access model capabilities through consistent rules, while permissions, credentials, usage and service health could be managed centrally.
data.value: Med passende tilpassede lokale beregningsressourcer på plads etablerede Aiursoft et fælles indgangspunkt for AI-tjenester. Brugere og applikationer kunne få adgang til modellernes muligheder gennem konsistente regler, mens tilladelser, legitimationsoplysninger, forbrug og tjenestesundhed kunne håndteres centralt.
